title: Sum positive values
summary: Warm up with the loop + condition + accumulator pattern used throughout data analysis.
description: Implement double sum_positive(const std::vector<double>& values). Return the sum of values strictly greater than zero.
requirements: Do not modify the input vector.
hints: A range-for loop plus one if statement is enough.
learning_goal: Traverse a vector, make a decision for each value, and accumulate a numeric result.
